text:
sam: FYI I opened a docs PR to consolidate Dedicated autoscale defaults, plus a short migration note for label normalization. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/6795

ivy: skimmed. nice consolidation. two asks: 1) include a one-line 'how to override defaults per reservation' example, and 2) clarify the SLA sentence so customers don't assume reroutes are covered.

sam: added an override snippet and tightened SLA language to: \"Automatic reroutes to hosted variants are excluded from Dedicated SLA unless explicitly stated in contract.\"

leo: small technical note: our infra now expects `preemption_policy: allow-preempt` (not `best-effort`). please update any YAML examples. also the cooldown default bump from 60->120s should be called out in the changelog. ops will want a migration playbook.

sam: updated YAML and added a short migration checklist with jq/CLI checks. paste of the per-reservation override example: 

```yaml
reservation:
  name: analytics-prod
  autoscale:
    cooldown_seconds: 30  # override shorter for latency-sensitive bursts
    preemption_policy: allow-preempt
```

ivy: can you also show a routing policy example that falls back to a quantized model when Dedicated is saturated? ops likes a curl example they can paste into runbooks.

sam: added this curl snippet to the PR description:

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/routing/policies \\
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" \\
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\
  -d '{\"reservation_id\":\"res-123\",\"fallback\": {\"model\":\"gptq-7b\",\"quantized\":true}}'
```

ops-bot: deploy preview ready: https://deploy-preview-6795--docs.redwood.ai (2026-03-23T12:40:12Z) :white_check_mark:

leo: looks good. one last nit: in migration checklist step 2, we should recommend to take a label snapshot before running remap. otherwise ok to merge after changelog entry.

sam: added snapshot step and a one-line release-note blurb about cooldown default change. merging tomorrow AM unless someone objects. :thumbsup:

docs-preview-bot: PR merged by sam into main (commit b3d9aa) — publish queued.

sam: closing thread. followups: perf graphs and a runbook example in /handbook/ops on my todo list.
